title: Deleting an Object from the Active Directory Object Safelist

blocks.text: You can delete an Active Directory (AD) object that is marked safe from the Active Directory Object Safelist.
To delete an AD object from the safelist:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Settings > Active Directory Object Safelist.
Select an AD domain from the Result for drop-down menu.
Under Actions, click the Delete icon to remove the object from the safelist.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
When you remove an object from the safelist, it gets added to the Focus Area page and the new and previous vulnerability reports for the selected issue.
